Get pipeline issues only

Source: R/sensitivity.R
get_pipeline_issues.Rd

Convenience function to extract only pipeline steps with validation issues.

Usage

get_pipeline_issues(coin, SA_specs)

Arguments

coin

A coin object.

SA_specs

A list of sensitivity specifications.

Value

A data frame containing only steps with issues, or an empty data frame if no issues are detected. A message is printed if no issues are found.

See also

get_sensitivity_pipeline()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
issues <- get_pipeline_issues(coin, SA_specs)
if (nrow(issues) > 0) {
  print(issues[, c("step_id", "issue_type", "issue_message")])
}
} # }
